race.description: Tab Were On Country Boosted Showcase Mdn Hcp
race.comment: LATIN LIGHTS (7) indicated a win was imminent second up when she raced handy from the wide gate for a courageous second over 1430m at Grafton. Well drawn today and can get off the mark at start seven. OCCUPATION (2) racing well from the wide gates in all three career starts and finally comes up with a decent barrier here. Covered plenty of ground from the wide gate before launching late to finish third over 1400m at Coffs Harbour. Best form puts him right in this. SORRENTI (1) consistent gelding at his top for this third up. Kept finding in the heavy (10) going with a game third over 1250m at Ballina. Bred to get the trip and can play a major role. DIDIE'S MEADOW (5) total forgive at her second run from a spell when snagged back from the outside draw to finish ninth over 1200m at the Gold Coast. Will race a touch closer and can take a hand in the finish.
